text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm passing by the dorms...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! I'm okay, Flower. It's not bad enough that I need to take the day off.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... if you push yourself any more,
you'll
collapse from exhaustion!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Creek's caught a cold, but she doesn't
want to
rest. She says she still has things
to do...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Laundry, vacuuming, bedtime stories...
Everyone
needs me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I have to be there for them...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Creek...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You can leave all of that to me! I'll look
after
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But... but that means I won't get to
pamper... No,
I mean—I would hate to
cause you trouble,
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it's no trouble at all! I want to help!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wish I could look after them
myself... but
okay.
choice_data_list: Why not leave it up to them?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you, I'm sure you'll be a great
mommy
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll try my best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, hi! I'm here to deliver your lunch
box on
Creek's behalf.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Did you... arrange the food to look like
me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Creek suggested I make something
you can
have fun eating. I jam-packed it
with all your
favorite foods! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. Thank you. Hehe, it's very cute.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Taishin,
your training partner has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What? Didn't Creek leave school early
today?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why I'm here to run with you
instead! I
can hold my own up to medium

distance—promise!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A-all right, all right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya really don't gotta do this, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. I'm here in Creek's stead!
I'll
massage all your fatigue away!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Thanks a bunch. You're real
considerate,
aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, Creek told me to give you a
thorough
massage after training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And then after that,
I think she said... to
give you
a pat on the head for good
measure?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck ya will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower's day of being a
mommy
comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was more tiring than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Creek is amazing. She helps out so many
people.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She was there for me too, when I first
arrived at
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling lonely, but she told me I
could rely
on her as if she were my own
mother. It was so
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to be just as reliable as she is
one
day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to be just as reliable as she is
one
day.
choice_data_list: You were completely on point today!
You were completely on point today!
Your feelings reached me loud and ...
I hope you can become one someday.
It'd be nice if you could become o...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much.
choice_data_list: You were completely on point today!
You were completely on point today!
Your feelings reached me loud and ...
I hope you can become one someday.
It'd be nice if you could become o...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My approach was probably different
from
Creek's... but I hope the others
found it just as
helpful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!
choice_data_list: You have every right to be confident.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and um... I did something for you
too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is a potpourri that I made, full of
scents to
relieve fatigue. If you'd like,
it's yours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, I'm able to enjoy a
productive
work session thanks to the
potpourri Nishino
Flower gave me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I hope so! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you free? I brought
some
homegrown tea leaves with me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if you'd like to try them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tea Nishino Flower brews for me is
delicious. Her gratitude toward me for
accompanying her
today is apparent in
every sip.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! After today, I feel like I've
gotten a
little closer to getting there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I grow up, I want to be just as kind
and
dependable as Creek! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there. Mommy's here for you,
honey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm here too! So...
just relax and let us
spoil you,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Got it! Thanks for the advice!
choice_data_list: No... just make sure not to push y...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That sudden fever dream... Could it have
been a
sign of things to come?
